description: A technical shell with a generous hood, articulated sleeves and discreet zip pockets. A clean outer layer for a considered city wardrobe.
A technical pullover with a half zip and roomy front pocket. The relaxed shape leaves space for a light layer underneath.
A hooded shell with a covered front fastening and a slightly longer hem. Designed as a fictional everyday outerwear concept.
A pared-back windbreaker with a stand collar, curved seams and elasticated cuffs. Its quiet palette pairs easily with the utility collection.
A long parka with a structured hood and generous patch pockets. The extended silhouette anchors the collection's architectural proportions.
A stand-collar jacket with shaped elbow seams and a subtle chest pocket. A streamlined option for layered daily outfits.
Clean travel trousers with a straight leg and discreet side pockets. Restrained colorways keep the shape versatile across the sample wardrobe.
Technical trousers with curved panel seams and a neat tapered leg. A considered counterpoint to the shell collection.
Drawstring trousers with elasticated cuffs and a relaxed top block. The understated shape works with both tees and overshirts.
Knee-length technical shorts with an elasticated waist and compact utility pocket. A warm-weather interpretation of the technical wardrobe.
A sleeveless utility layer with a small collar and front storage pockets. Wear it over a tee or beneath an open shell.
A fleece concept with a visible grid texture and a low stand collar. Raglan sleeves give the piece an easy layered shape.
A crew-neck tee with restrained side-panel details. A simple base for building outfits around the more structured pieces.
A long-sleeve top with a half zip and tall collar. The clean silhouette slips beneath the sample shells without visual bulk.
An overshirt with snap fastenings and broad chest pockets. A shirt-jacket shape for the space between casual and structured dressing.
A fitted base-layer concept with subtle ribbing and flat-looking seams. Thermal is a fictional product name, not a tested warmth rating.
A compact sling with an adjustable webbing strap and separate front pocket. Sized as a small everyday carry concept.
A roll-top daypack concept with contrasting straps and a vertical front zip. Its simple volume echoes the collection's architectural theme.
An unbranded five-panel cap with a curved brim and adjustable back strap. A quiet finishing piece for the sample wardrobe.
A rib-knit beanie with a broad folded cuff and short crown. No patch or graphic interrupts the simple shape.
A webbing belt with a flat adjustable buckle. Available in two sample length ranges; check the fictional size guide before selecting.
A small zip pouch with a wrist loop and a separate front pocket. A compact companion for the utility wardrobe.
